prompt: A grove village around the big oak I planted.

card.name: Oakheart Grove

site.text: A grove village built around the big oak the player planted, houses and paths ringed among the trees

style.text: Woodland grove: oak and spruce timber, leaf roofs, moss, lanterns among the branches

purpose.text: A peaceful grove village to live in, centred on the planted oak

card.interpretation: A village laid out in a ring around your planted oak, using the existing land at your spot. Style is a rustic woodland look, purpose is a calm home base, and the buildings are a hall facing the oak plus cottages, a woodcutter, a herb shop, a shrine and a barn.
assumptions: Size is M, as none was given
Purpose read as a home base
Oak is at the claim centre, village sits within the 64-block claim

program.notes: Gathering hall facing the big oak, open timber frame, lanterns hung from branches
Small homes among the trees, mossy roofs, ringed around the oak
Small open shrine of leaves and stone
